name: Image File Execution Options / AppInit_DLLs
os_min: Windows Vista (IFEO Debugger abuse formalized); AppInit_DLLs from Windows NT
location: HKLM\SOFTWARE{\Wow6432Node}\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\<executable>\Debugger; AppInit_DLLs at HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Windows
purpose: IFEO Debugger value causes a specified debugger/program to launch in place of (or before) the target executable; AppInit_DLLs forces a DLL to load into every process that loads user32.dll.
key_fields: Debugger value under an executable's IFEO key
normal_baseline: IFEO keys typically empty or used only by legitimate debugging/compatibility tooling; AppInit_DLLs typically empty on modern systems (deprecated with secure boot).
anomalies: Debugger value attached to an accessibility or security-tool binary (e.g. utilman.exe, taskmgr.exe)
AppInit_DLLs pointing to an unsigned DLL in a user-writable path
anti_forensic_notes: IFEO abuse can double as defense evasion by attaching an invalid or crashing debugger to security tools, silently disabling them.
